`final class Bezier`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.geom` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Bezier.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/geom/Bezier.java)

Computes the points of quadratic and cubic Bézier curves.

## Description

The curve functions of [`DrawUtils`](/reference/drawing/drawutils/) use it to sample their curves.

## Learn more

- [Drawing shapes and text](/use/learn/going-further/drawing/)

## Method details

<a id="Bezier-method-quadratic"></a>

### quadratic

`Point quadratic(double t, Point start, Point control, Point end)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the point at `t` (from `0D` at `start` to `1D` at `end`) of the curve pulled toward `control`.

<a id="Bezier-method-cubic"></a>

### cubic

`Point cubic(double t, Point start, Point startControl, Point endControl, Point end)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the point at `t` (from `0D` at `start` to `1D` at `end`) of the curve that leaves `start` toward `startControl` and reaches `end` from `endControl`.
